definitions.gloss: registering a marriage; entering a family register
definitions.explanation: The act of submitting a marriage registration to the local government office, which legally establishes the marriage. In everyday use, often synonymous with getting legally married.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昨日|きのう}→昨日：00859_kinou⟧{入籍|にゅうせき}⟦しました→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{入籍|にゅうせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{済|す}ませた→済む：01950_sumu⟧。
examples.english: We completed the marriage registration before the wedding ceremony.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{記念日|きねんび}→記念日：05585_kinenbi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}わせて→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧{入籍|にゅうせき}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧です。
examples.english: We plan to register our marriage on our anniversary.

notes: Literally means 'entering the family register' (⟦{戸籍|こせき}→戸籍：12695_koseki⟧). In Japan, a marriage becomes legally valid when the ⟦{婚姻届|こんいんとどけ}→婚姻届：22413_konintodoke⟧ (marriage registration form) is submitted to the ⟦{役所|やくしょ}→役所：06455_yakusho⟧ (government office), not when a ceremony is held. Common collocations: {入籍|にゅうせき}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to register a marriage), {入籍届|にゅうせきとどけ} (registration form), {入籍日|にゅうせきび} (registration date). Many couples choose a meaningful date for {入籍|にゅうせき}, such as a holiday or anniversary. Often used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ as a verb.
